tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the Perkadoo projects available to the authenticated MCP credential.

tools.name: get_streak_performance
tools.description: Read the streak distribution, best streaks and progress for a program. Excludes synthetic test activity.

tools.name: get_proof_report
tools.description: Read the latest holdout experiment, its sample sizes and measured return rate. Returns null when no experiment exists; never invents uplift.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List a brand's streak programs with their event key, cadence, target and status.

tools.name: list_perks
tools.description: List a brand's perks with how many have been granted, revealed to members and redeemed, and for coupons with a code pool, how many codes are left and how many grants are waiting for one.

tools.name: create_perk
tools.description: Create a reward a brand can give members: a coupon code, a link or a message. Milestone rewards set in the dashboard are perks too.

tools.name: create_giveaway
tools.description: Draft a hosted giveaway: prize, dates, draw, entry page, bonus entries and official rules. It starts as a draft with a preview link. A signed-in person approves it at dashboardUrl before it goes live; send them that link.

tools.name: update_giveaway
tools.description: Change a giveaway before it's drawn. Changing its dates, draw, prizes, rules or bonus entries clears its approval and returns it to draft; pause a live giveaway first. Headline, description, image and colour can change any time.

tools.name: get_giveaway
tools.description: Read a giveaway with its phase, approval, links, winners and numbers: entrants, entries, sources, entries by day, top referrers and flagged entries. dashboardUrl is where a signed-in person approves it or, once approved, draws it.

tools.name: list_giveaways
tools.description: List a brand's giveaways, newest first, with their phase and entry counts.

tools.name: list_giveaway_entries
tools.description: List a giveaway's entries, newest first, with email, entries, source, referrer, status and risk signals. Filter by status to review flagged entries.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: See how many new faces or returning members a brand has toward its goal, the target, the deadline and whether it's on pace. Returns null when no goal is set.

tools.name: set_goal
tools.description: Aim a brand at more new faces or more returning members: a number to reach by a deadline. Doo plans around it and Home tracks it. Replaces the current goal, which is kept as history.

tools.name: make_winners_card
tools.description: Make a square card announcing a drawn giveaway's winners, with emails masked: a public page link and a PNG to post. It publishes nothing itself.

tools.name: get_draw
tools.description: Read and verify a Winner Picker result from its public slug. If randomness is now available, completes the previously committed draw. Returns the original winners and share image; never picks a replacement winner.

tools.name: create_share_card
tools.description: Make a card for a win, streak, perk, giveaway entry or winner announcement. Returns a public page and PNG image in square, story or link size. Uses supplied text; it does not verify a winner, grant a perk or publish a social post. Never put private tokens or coupon codes in a card.

tools.name: draw_winners
tools.description: Pick random winners from a list of names with Perkadoo's Winner Picker. The draw uses public drand randomness that didn't exist when the names were locked in, so anyone can check it. Returns the winners and a public results link to share.

tools.name: read_post_comments
tools.description: Read every top-level comment on a public post from its link, with no account: YouTube videos. Returns the post (title, the account that posted it) and each comment's handle, text and time, ready for draw_winners or a comment picker. Instagram needs the brand's connected account instead.

tools.name: create_streak_badge
tools.description: Start a personal streak for any habit with Perkadoo's Streak Badge, no account needed. Returns a public streak page, a live SVG badge for a README or website, and a private check-in link. The check-in link is the only way to check in, so tell the person to save it.

tools.name: check_in_streak_badge
tools.description: Check in today on a Perkadoo Streak Badge with its private token. One check-in per day in the streak's time zone; checking in again the same day changes nothing. Missing a day starts the streak over.

tools.name: get_streak_badge
tools.description: Read a Perkadoo Streak Badge: the live streak, best streak, total days and the last seven days.

tools.name: build_prebuild_from_site
tools.description: Give Doo your site's address. Doo reads it and builds your giveaway, daily streak and perks in your brand colors, then returns a private preview link. Nothing goes live until you make it yours from that page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_giveaway_entries, read_post_comments · Private data: list_projects, create_share_card, create_streak_badge, check_in_streak_badge, build_prebuild_from_site · Public sink: create_giveaway, list_giveaway_entries, make_winners_card, get_draw, create_share_card, draw_winners, read_post_comments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_giveaway_entries, read_post_comments · Private data: list_projects, create_share_card, create_streak_badge, check_in_streak_badge, build_prebuild_from_site · Public sink: create_giveaway, list_giveaway_entries, make_winners_card, get_draw, create_share_card, draw_winners, read_post_comments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
